data.name: Frontier Ferris For Adventurers
data.detailed_description:
Overview

This is the remote region of Ferris—a frontier untouched by humanity.

As an adventurer, you’ll risk your life to challenge this untamed land.

Hunt dangerous wildlife, chop down trees, and break rocks to gather resources.

Craft weapons and items at your workbench.

And of course, you can’t go without your daily meals.

Key Features

  • Gathering: Use tools you’ve crafted to gather various resources.

  • Crafting: Craft items to suit your playstyle. At first, you can only make basic equipment, but as you progress, you’ll be able to craft higher-tier gear.

  • Survival: Cooking is essential to maintain your hunger and stamina. Gather ingredients through hunting and gathering, then cook them.

  • World Map: Clearing stage-based battlefields unlocks new areas to explore.

  • Gear up and take on the challenges of new regions.

  • Adventurers’ Guild and Shops: You can accept quests at the guild. This allows you to earn resources efficiently.

data.short_description: This is a stage-based, real-time battle action game with survival elements. You can gather resources and craft equipment and food. Defeating the boss of each stage unlocks new stages. Let’s continue to develop the frontier of Felis.
